introduction:
Metrology and measurement are essential aspects of mechanical engineering, playing a critical role in manufacturing, quality control, machine performance, and product reliability. Accurate measurement ensures dimensional precision, proper functioning of machine components, and compliance with engineering standards. Metrology involves the science of measurement, including the principles of measuring instruments, calibration, measurement accuracy, precision, and the identification and minimization of measurement errors.

The Virtual Metrology and Measurement Laboratory provides an interactive platform for students to understand the principles, operation, and applications of various measuring instruments and techniques. The laboratory covers experiments on pressure gauge and strain gauge calibration, displacement measurement using LVDT, taper measurement using a sine bar, optical flats, alignment measurement, gear tooth measurement, and screw thread measurement. Through virtual experiments, students can explore different measurement parameters, analyze results, identify sources of error, and understand methods to improve measurement accuracy.

These experiments will strengthen students’ conceptual understanding and practical skills, preparing them to perform experiments confidently in a physical laboratory and apply measurement principles to real-world engineering and manufacturing applications.

experiments.name: Calibration of Pressure Gauge using Dead Weight Gauge Calibrator
Measurement of Taper using Sine Bar
Measurement of Gear Tooth Profile using Gear Tooth Vernier and Gear Tooth Micrometer
Study and Use of Optical Flats
Measurement of Screw Threads Parameters using Two-Wire or Three-Wire Methods
Measurement of Flatness of a Surface using Autocollimator

UG: B.Tech / BE in Mechanical Engineering 2nd-year and 3rd-year students

objective: The objectives of the Metrology and Measurement Laboratory are to provide students with hands-on experience and a fundamental understanding of the key concepts of metrology and measurement. The laboratory aims to develop skills in identifying and minimising measurement errors, understanding modern measurement techniques used in advanced machinery, and learning the working principles and operation of various measuring instruments.
